t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There is a red basket and a yellow basket. The colour of each gnome corresponds to either one of the basket and this is based on how close the colour is to the basket colour. I.e. purple leads to red because blue + red = purple

vb_textbox.text: Each colour of gnome corresponds to a colour of basket. There are two colour of baskets: red and yellow. To reach a red basket choose the colour of gnome that is closer to the colour red, i.e. purple gnome because blue+red=purple. To reach a yellow basket choose the colour of gnome that is closer to the colour yellow or furthest away from the colour red, i.e. a yellow or blue gnome. Try reaching both the red basket and yellow basket and see which one gives you more mushrooms, once you get a feel of which colour yields the greater amount of mushrooms stick to it to make sure you harvest the most amount of mushrooms, but you should switch it up also as the other colour of basket might now yield a greater amount of mushrooms.
